explication: Warmbly is an open-source cold-email, mailbox-warmup, and team collaboration platform. Users connect their own mailboxes, configure campaigns and sequences, and the control-plane API coordinates state and work for interchangeable workers; campaign activity and replies then appear in a shared inbox and dashboard. The README also identifies CRM, deliverability, automations, integrations, and realtime collaboration as major capabilities. The graph follows those documented product areas and the documented control-plane/event-bus/worker split; implementation detail beyond the sampled files is intentionally limited.
